phase_note: Generated 2026-09-15/16 by the Phase 7 spec batch (wave 2) in auto-approve mode. 8 requirements / 58 acceptance criteria; 14 design components; 3 major tasks / 12 executable tasks (1.2 and 1.3 parallel; 2.3 parallel with 2.2 after 2.1; 3.3 and 3.4 parallel after 3.1/3.2).
